description: Estimates the monthly return on an SEO investment from extra organic visits, conversion rate, value per conversion and monthly SEO cost, plus the break-even traffic gain.

conversion_rate_pct.description: Share of visits that convert, as a percentage.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

gross_margin_pct.description: Optional gross margin as a percentage. Leave out to measure on revenue.

monthly_organic_visits_gain.description: Extra organic visits per month expected from SEO.

monthly_seo_cost.description: Monthly SEO spend, in currency units.

value_per_conversion.description: Average revenue per conversion (order value or deal value), in currency units.

name: seo_roi
title: SEO ROI
